description: This file implements logging functionalities for the prplMesh project, including classes for log rolling and network logging, and manages log levels, configurations, and settings using the EasyLogging++ library.

classes.name: RollMonitor
classes.description: Handles log file size monitoring and log rolling by invoking an external script when size exceeds threshold.

classes.name: NetLogger
classes.description: Sends log messages over the network to a specified server and port.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the log rolling monitor.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles log dispatch data, triggers log rolling if file size exceeds limit.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Configures network logger with server, port, and module name.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Builds and sends log message over socket.

methods.name: log_level_to_string
methods.description: Converts log level enum to string.

methods.name: log_levels::parse_string
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string to set log levels.

methods.name: log_levels::set_log_level_state
methods.description: Sets the enabled/disabled state for a specific log level.

methods.name: log_levels::to_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of current log levels.

methods.name: logging::apply_settings
methods.description: Applies current logging configuration to the logger.

methods.name: logging::load_settings
methods.description: Loads logging settings from a configuration file.

methods.name: logging::save_settings
methods.description: Saves current logging settings to a configuration file.

methods.name: logging::eval_settings
methods.description: Evaluates and updates internal settings based on configuration.
